import json, subprocess, copy, random

def run(ops):
 p=subprocess.run(['python3','run.py'],input=json.dumps({'cases':[{'ops':ops}]}).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 assert p.returncode==0,(p.stderr,p.stdout[:1000])
 return json.loads(p.stdout)['results'][0]

def empty():return dict(root=None,front16=[],front64=[],cells=[0]*11,banks=[[]for _ in range(11)],bitmaps=[],nexthops=[])
def word(x):return f'{x:064x}'
def inline(f,l,h):return f | (l<<64) | (h<<72)
NULL=4194303
ABS=15<<6

def child(k,s,c):return k|(s<<6)|(c<<10)
def leaf(k,hop,bmp=None,origin=0,depth=6):
 # child /6 inline and BMP includes exactly that /6
 bmp=hop if bmp is None else bmp
 return 4|(bmp<<3)|(inline(k<<58,6,hop)<<25)

# Independent TYPE3 image with arbitrary direct keys/stages/slots.  All
# children own /6 routes and thus have equal-depth-inclusive BMPs.
for nd in range(4):
 d=empty();d['root']=[10,0]
 direct_keys=[1,3,9][:nd]
 bulk_keys=[k for k in range(10) if k not in direct_keys]
 bm=sum(1<<k for k in bulk_keys)
 root=3|(NULL<<3)|(bm<<63)|(0<<127)|(4<<149)
 for i in range(3):root|=(child(direct_keys[i],3,nd-1-i) if i<nd else ABS)<<(153+32*i)
 d['cells'][10]=2;d['banks'][10]=[word(root)]
 d['cells'][4]=2*len(bulk_keys);d['banks'][4]=[word(leaf(k,k)) for k in bulk_keys]
 halves=[leaf(k,k) for k in reversed(direct_keys)]
 d['cells'][3]=len(halves);d['banks'][3]=[word(halves[i]|((halves[i+1]if i+1<len(halves)else 0)<<128))for i in range(0,len(halves),2)]
 d['bitmaps']=['0000000000000000']
 qs=[f'{k<<122:032x}' for k in range(64)]
 r=run([['load',d],['image_query',qs],['save']])
 assert r['loads']==[True],(nd,r)
 assert r['answers']==list(range(10))+[None]*54,(nd,r['answers'])
 assert r['snapshots']==[empty()]
 print('arbitrary TYPE3 direct count',nd,'accepted')

# TYPE2 can be in any stage; NI zero used and all local arrays empty base0.
d=empty();d['root']=[7,0];d['cells'][7]=2;d['cells'][1]=3
d['banks'][7]=[word(2|(NULL<<3)|sum((child(i,1,i)if i<3 else ABS)<<(63+32*i)for i in range(6)))]
d['banks'][1]=[word(leaf(0,0)|(leaf(1,1)<<128)),word(leaf(2,2))];d['bitmaps']=['0000000000000000']
r=run([['load',d],['image_query',[f'{i<<122:032x}'for i in range(4)]]]);assert r['loads']==[True] and r['answers']==[0,1,2,None]
print('TYPE2 arbitrary stage, odd-cell half accepted')

# TYPE1 with no children and l=0,1,2 local prefixes.  Keep /0 even
# when its hop matches another prefix; check NI increasing position.
d=empty();d['root']=[8,0];d['cells'][8]=1
d['banks'][8]=[word(1|(11<<3)|(ABS<<63)|(ABS<<95))]
d['bitmaps']=[f'{(1<<1)|(1<<2)|(1<<4):016x}'];d['nexthops']=[11,22,22]
r=run([['load',d],['image_query',[f'{x:032x}'for x in [0,1<<126,1<<127]]]])
assert r['loads']==[True] and r['answers']==[22,22,11],r
print('TYPE1 /0 and local NI accepted')

# Permuted NI segments are legal. Dictionary entries sorted by numeric
# pattern (including zero only when used) are not coupled to NI order.
# Obtain two TYPE1 roots, each local prefixes /17,/18,/19 under different keys.
ops=[]
for key in [0x1234,0x5678]:
 for j,l in enumerate([17,18,19]): ops.append(['put',f'{key<<112:032x}',l,key+j])
d=run(ops+[['save']])['snapshots'][0]
assert len(d['nexthops'])==6
# Both roots at same stage, packed into two halves. Swap their segment bases.
s=d['front16'][0][1]
x=int(d['banks'][s][0],16)
mask=((1<<22)-1)
a=(x>>41)&mask;b=(x>>(128+41))&mask
x &= ~(mask<<41);x &= ~(mask<<(128+41));x|=b<<41;x|=a<<(128+41)
d['banks'][s][0]=word(x);d['nexthops']=d['nexthops'][3:]+d['nexthops'][:3]
r=run([['load',d],['image_query',[f'{key<<112:032x}'for key in[0x1234,0x5678]]]])
assert r['loads']==[True] and r['answers']==[0x1236,0x567a],r
print('permuted NI arrays accepted')

# Test bad BMP/host/reserved bits/compactness/side-array coverage atomically.
base=empty();base['root']=[0,0];base['cells'][0]=1
base['banks'][0]=[word(4|(9<<3)|(inline(0,0,9)<<25))]
ops=[['load',base]];expected_loads=[True];expected_answers=[]
def reject(d):
 ops.extend([['load',d],['image_query',['0'*32]]]);expected_loads.append(False);expected_answers.append(9)
# Single default route changing each reserved bit or host fragment must fail.
for i in list(range(119,256))+list(range(25,89)):
 d=copy.deepcopy(base);d['banks'][0][0]=word(int(d['banks'][0][0],16)^(1<<i));reject(d)
for field,val in [('bitmaps',['0000000000000000']),('nexthops',[3]),('root',None)]:
 d=copy.deepcopy(base);d[field]=val;reject(d)
# batches max16 loads
for start in range(1,len(ops),30):
 batch=ops[:1]+ops[start:start+30]
 r=run(batch)
 assert r['loads']==[True]+[False]*((len(batch)-1)//2),r['loads']
 assert r['answers']==[9]*((len(batch)-1)//2),r['answers']
print('host/reserved/coverage corruption rejected atomically')
